subject: science
learning_objective: Distinguish energy transfer from energy being used up or disappearing.
text: Common misconception: energy disappears when an object stops moving. Better teaching move: trace where the energy went, such as into sound, heat, or deformation, and ask students to account for the full system.

metadata.misconception: Energy is used up and gone.
metadata.correction: Energy transfers or transforms within a system.

subject: science
learning_objective: Explain that motion can continue even when no net force acts on an object.
text: Common misconception: an object needs a continuous force to keep moving. Better teaching move: separate force from motion by comparing a sliding object slowing because of friction with an ideal low-friction situation.

metadata.misconception: Moving objects always require a forward force.
metadata.correction: A net force changes motion; friction often slows objects.
